tools.pytest-cov: tool: coverage for the acquisition gate
tools.ruff: tool: formatter and linter run by pre-commit
tools.mypy: tool: type checker run by pre-commit
tools.boto3-stubs: tool: type stubs for MyPy (boto3, matches boto3)
tools.botocore-stubs: tool: type stubs for MyPy (botocore, matches botocore)
tools.pyyaml: dynamic: imported by name in repo_checks.load_yaml (front-matter check) and package_fixture.check; pre-commit installs the same version.
tools.yamllint: tool: YAML source checks through scripts/quality/lint_sources.py

provided.hai_bootstrap: the first-party services/hai/bootstrap sources exposed as hai_bootstrap by the runner image; the host uses services.hai.bootstrap
provided.dbt: the pinned dbt-core and dbt-duckdb of the sqlfluff group (.tools/sqlfluff), which scripts/lakehouse/run_duckdb_spill_cases.py runs under (.tools/sqlfluff/bin/python); .venv has neither
provided.jsonschema: pinned for the acquisition collectors in config/acquisition/runtime_dependencies.json
provided.referencing: pinned for the acquisition collectors in config/acquisition/runtime_dependencies.json

review.reason: Schema-review tools run on the host with .review_dependencies on PYTHONPATH (the review group of pyproject.toml).

spark.reason: The lakehouse jobs that scripts/lakehouse/catalog.py runs in the Spark image, the gold publish steps and their case suite, and the modules only they use.

provided.pyspark: the checksum-verified Spark distribution in services/lakehouse/spark/Dockerfile

analytics.reason: The DuckDB UI relay runs in the analytics image.

provided.dbt: the module of dbt-core, pinned in the analytics group of uv.lock; the host environment does not install dbt-core, so deptry cannot map the module to its package

quality.reason: Great Expectations validation of the silver build file (scripts/lakehouse/silver.py validate starts it) and the gold publish export of the sealed copy run in the quality image.

orchestration.reason: The DAG files, the in-image checks and the metadata dump run inside the Airflow image that services/orchestration/Dockerfile builds from the official image (Airflow plan section 11.1).

provided.airflow: the official Airflow image pinned by digest in services/orchestration/Dockerfile
provided.psycopg2: the PostgreSQL driver of the official Airflow image (psycopg2-binary in the orchestration group of uv.lock)
provided.openlineage: the provider and client in the orchestration group of uv.lock

feature_store.reason: The Feast repository and the Feast, online-store and historical-read jobs run in the Feast image (services/feature_store/Dockerfile). The feature_store group of uv.lock pins them with hashes.

serving.reason: The model API runs in the image that services/model_api/Dockerfile builds. The model_api group of uv.lock pins its packages with hashes.

streamlit_page.reason: The Streamlit page runs in the image that services/streamlit/Dockerfile builds. The streamlit group of uv.lock pins its packages with hashes. The client, the words and the stand-in use the standard library only.

sqlfluff.reason: A tool environment (.tools/sqlfluff) with no project code.

dvc.reason: A tool environment (.tools/dvc) with no project code: the pinned DVC and its S3 remote for the training baseline.

drift.reason: The drift check runs in the drift image (services/drift) with Evidently, DuckDB and jsonschema, installed from the drift group of uv.lock.
